title: Stable intelligence — deeper analysis without breaking the shell
summary: YTIntel keeps the proven one-owner v0.38 shell and upgrades the heart of Analyse: interpretation is separated from transcript receipts, key takeaways are source-backed, Creator DNA drives a concrete remake blueprint, media enrichment is bounded and optional, and cross-checks fail visibly instead of hanging.
discord_changes: 🧠 INTELLIGENCE UPGRADE: Summary and Key Takeaways now separate interpretation from exact transcript receipts instead of presenting transcript lines as the insight.
🎯 MAKE IT YOURS: the zero-credit blueprint now uses Creator DNA + the source video’s hook/proof/structure mechanics to produce three distinct directions without copying source wording.
🧾 CROSS-CHECK: transcript availability, WPM plausibility, Most Replayed availability, takeaway quote grounding and visual/audio limitations are checked explicitly.
🧱 STABILITY PRESERVED: the app still boots through one HTML script owner. Optional media and local-AI enrichment are timeout-bounded and can never hold the 17-section report at a fake percentage.
changes: Preserved the v0.38 one-script stable shell and its independent Analyse / Competitors / Vault navigation.
Added a single bounded v0.39 intelligence enhancement layer after the proven zero-credit core; no old-version loader chain was restored.
Rebuilt the watch-replacement Summary into 10–15 chronological interpreted beats with exact transcript receipts underneath and a guarded why-it-likely-popped verdict.
Rebuilt Key Takeaways so facts/list videos preserve evidenced list items while other videos produce actionable mechanics with exact receipts.
Expanded Make It Yours into three mechanically distinct Creator-DNA directions with title, hook, thumbnail, beat sheet, steal/do-not-copy and measurement guidance.
Added a deterministic cross-check for transcript presence, WPM plausibility, public Most Replayed availability, quote grounding and source limitations.
Added an optional 12-second media enrichment request. When YouTube exposes storyboard samples or public music metadata they are surfaced; when it does not, the core report still completes normally.
Added explicit research-stage telemetry and a no-silent-hang message if a source stage stops moving, while retaining the core source timeout.
Added optional on-device LanguageModel synthesis only when the browser already supports a ready local model; it never calls a paid cloud model and never blocks core completion.
Kept phone containment and mobile navigation from v0.38.
known_limitations: Zero paid API credits means YTIntel still cannot guarantee Claude Max / frontier cloud-model reasoning quality.
On-device model availability depends on the user’s browser/device; deterministic intelligence remains the default fallback.
YouTube does not expose storyboards, direct media, subscriber counts or Most Replayed for every video/request. Missing media evidence remains explicitly limited.
Storyboard samples are seek-bar frames, not every encoded frame; sampled stills alone cannot prove every cut, zoom, transition, text overlay or sound effect.
Public Most Replayed is replay/seek interest, not private audience-retention data and is never described as causal proof.
why_it_matters: The stable website is no longer the finish line. v0.39 keeps that stability while moving the actual product back toward the 07/09 Monday Brief: save the watch time, explain the mechanics, show the receipt, and finish with a video direction the creator can actually use.
